interface.ports: Original names, directions, scalar widths, and output reg declarations preserved.

semantics.evidence: Original uses always @(*) with incomplete if assignments; no clock or reset ports exist. Fix missing assignments to prevent inferred latches.
semantics.keep_driving: If arrived is false, complement gas_tank_empty; otherwise 0.
semantics.timing: Combinational response after simulator settling; no added cycles or state.
semantics.reset_initialization: No reset or initial value is specified; outputs determined by current inputs, no retained history.

numeric.width: All ports are one-bit unsigned; constants explicitly one-bit.
numeric.arithmetic: Only Boolean conditions and one-bit complement; no rounding, overflow, or saturation.

verification.oracle: Original conditional intent, independent explicit Boolean truth table for all eight binary combinations.
verification.coverage: All previous/current binary input pairs, including overheating deassertion and arrival after driving; compare after #1 settling.
verification.failure: Case-inequality checks with $fatal; bounded timeout; PASS marker only on success.

specification_ambiguities.issue: Intro calls this an adder-subtractor with zero flag, but supplied module has unrelated control ports.
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Use supplied module and port-level conditional intent.

specification_ambiguities.issue: Missing else behavior is not explicitly written.
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Interpret bug as unintended latches; add zero-valued else branches for safe shutdown/driving control.

specification_ambiguities.issue: Unknown or high-impedance input behavior is unspecified.
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Do not claim a required four-state truth table beyond ordinary Verilog if and bitwise complement semantics; test all binary inputs.
